# Ermengarde

*Bookbinder*

|  |  |

## Personality

Placid, careful and fond of terrible puns. She smells of glue and old leather.

## Story

Ermengarde mends and binds the Academy's books in a tiny shop beside the library. She once found a letter sewn inside an old binding and has never told anyone what it said.
